aka.en: Jinan–Qingdao Expressway (Qingdao to Jinan; the 'northern line')
aka.zh: 济青高速公路（青岛至济南段，俗称“济青北线”）

aka.en: Taiyuan–Jiuguan Expressway (Taiyuan to the Hebei line)
aka.zh: 太旧高速公路（太原至冀晋界段）

tagline.en: Shandong's first expressway, carried west over the Taihang and Lüliang ranges and the Yellow River to Yinchuan
tagline.zh: 从山东第一条高速公路出发，向西翻越太行、吕梁，跨过黄河抵达银川

start.en: Helan interchange in Xingqing district, Yinchuan, Ningxia, on national road G211 — kilometre 1,510
start.zh: 宁夏回族自治区银川市兴庆区贺兰互通，接 211 国道——1,510 公里处

end.en: Liaoyang East Road interchange in Laoshan district, Qingdao — kilometre 0
end.zh: 山东省青岛市崂山区辽阳东路立交——零公里点

en: G20 runs 1,510 km on the chainage in Chinese Wikipedia, though it is often given as 1,600 or 1,610 km. From Qingdao it crosses the Shandong peninsula through Gaomi, Weifang, Qingzhou, Zibo and Zhangqiu to Jinan, crosses the Yellow River on the Jinan ring and continues west through Qihe, Gaotang and Xiajin into Hebei at Qinghe. It crosses the plain by Nangong, Ningjin and Zhao county to Shijiazhuang, climbs through Jingxing to the Shanxi line at Jiuguan, and runs through Yangquan and Yuci to Taiyuan. South-west of Taiyuan it passes Jinci, Wenshui and Fenyang, crosses the Lüliang mountains to Lishi and Liulin, bridges the Yellow River at Jundu, and in northern Shaanxi runs over the loess plateau through Wubu, Suide, Zizhou, Jingbian and Dingbian, then across the edge of the Mu Us desert into Ningxia at Yanchi and on to Yinchuan.

Shandong carries 457 km, Shanxi 368, Shaanxi 322, Hebei 225 and Ningxia 138. In the 1992 trunk-road plan it was one of the seven horizontal lines, numbered 035. Between Qingdao and Jinan it is the original Jinan–Qingdao expressway, which local traffic police and residents call the 'northern line' to tell it apart from the later southern line (G22) and middle line (the Jinan–Weifang expressway). When it was renumbered in 2010, the chainage on that section was reversed to count from Qingdao.
zh: 按中文维基百科的里程，G20 全长 1,510 公里，但也常见 1,600 或 1,610 公里的说法。它自青岛出发横贯山东半岛，经高密、潍坊、青州、淄博、章丘到济南，借济南绕城高速跨过黄河，再经齐河、高唐、夏津，在清河进入河北。此后经南宫、宁晋、赵县穿过平原到石家庄，经井陉上山，在旧关进入山西，经阳泉、榆次到太原。太原西南经晋祠、文水、汾阳，翻越吕梁山到离石、柳林，在军渡跨过黄河，进入陕北黄土高原，经吴堡、绥德、子洲、靖边、定边，再穿过毛乌素沙地边缘，在盐池进入宁夏，抵达银川。
山东段 457 公里，山西段 368 公里，陕西段 322 公里，河北段 225 公里，宁夏段 138 公里。在 1992 年的国道主干线规划中，它是“五纵七横”的七条横线之一，编号 035。青岛至济南段即原济青高速公路，交管部门和当地人称之为“济青北线”，以区别于后来通车的“济青南线”（青兰高速）和“济青中线”（济潍高速）。2010 年并入青银高速时，这一段的里程桩号改为自青岛起算。

en: The Jinan–Qingdao expressway, 318 km, was built to four lanes, designed for 100 km/h, on a roadbed 26 metres wide west of Weifang and 23 metres east of it, under FIDIC contract conditions with international tendering. Between 2016 and 2019 Shandong rebuilt 309 km of it to eight lanes while traffic kept running, mostly by adding lanes on both sides; at the time it was described as the longest and most expensive expressway widening carried out in one go in China.

The mountain sections in Shanxi are the hard ones. The 144 km Taiyuan–Jiuguan expressway through the Taihang mountains needed 17.87 million cubic metres of earthworks, two extra-large and 61 large and medium bridges and the Beiru tunnel; its builders called it the most arduous project in the province's road-building history, and more than 50,000 people worked on it at the peak. In March 2006 groundwater soaking the embankment in the spring thaw caused a collapse near Shouyang up to 8 metres deep, and the road was shut for nearly three months. Further west, bridges and tunnels make up 52.5% of the 38.55 km from Lishi to the Yellow River at Jundu, including what was reported as the longest twin-arch loess tunnel in China, and across the river in Shaanxi the 68 km from Wubu to Zizhou has 33 tunnels through loess.
zh: 济青高速公路全长 318 公里，按四车道修建，设计时速 100 公里，路基宽度潍坊以西 26 米、以东 23 米，采用菲迪克合同条件和国际招标。2016 至 2019 年间，山东在“边通车、边施工”的条件下将其中 309 公里改扩建为八车道，以两侧拼宽为主；当时被称为国内一次性扩建里程最长、投资最大的高速公路改扩建工程。

难点在山西山区。穿越太行山的太旧高速全长 144 公里，土石方 1,787 万立方米，建有特大桥 2 座、大中桥 61 座及北茹隧道；施工单位称之为山西筑路史上最艰巨的工程，高峰期有 5 万余名建设者。2006 年 3 月，因地下水位上升、春融时路基长期浸泡，寿阳段发生塌陷，最深达 8 米，道路封闭近三个月。再往西，离石至军渡黄河东岸 38.55 公里桥隧比达 52.5%，其中有报道称为全国最长的黄土连拱隧道；过河进入陕西，吴堡至子洲 68 公里内分布着 33 座黄土隧道。

en: The route begins with Shandong's first expressway. The Jinan–Qingdao road was begun at the turn of 1990, one of the World Bank's third group of highway loans in China, and opened on 18 December 1993, four months ahead of contract. Qingdao's local chronicle puts its 318 km second in length only to the Shenyang–Dalian expressway, and the Shandong yearbook called it the largest single investment yet in Chinese road building. The Taiyuan–Jiuguan road, Shanxi's first expressway, entered the national five-year plan in 1988, was approved in May 1992, begun in 1993 and fully opened on 25 June 1996.

The rest was built in the decade after 2000. Taiyuan–Fenyang opened in October 2000, Jingbian–Wangquanliang on the Ningxia border in January 2004, Fenyang–Lishi in October 2005, and Hebei's 182 km from Qinghe to Shijiazhuang on 28 December 2005. In 2005 the national plan numbered the line G20. Shaanxi's Wubu–Zizhou–Jingbian section opened on 31 October 2007, completing the province's 321 km, and Shanxi's last piece, Lishi to Jundu, on 18 December 2007.

The old Jinan–Qingdao road was signed as part of G20 in 2010, and the work since has been widening. The eight-lane Jinan–Qingdao rebuild reopened east of Xiaoxujia on 26 July 2019, Shandong's first eight-lane expressway. In Shanxi the 100.68 km from the Hebei line to Shouyang on the Taiyuan–Jiuguan road is being rebuilt to eight lanes, begun on 28 September 2024.
zh: 这条路始于山东省第一条高速公路。济青高速公路是世界银行第三批对华公路贷款项目之一，约于 1990 年前后动工，1993 年 12 月 18 日全线通车，比合同工期提前 4 个月。青岛市志称其 318 公里的长度仅次于沈大高速、居全国第二；《山东年鉴》称其为当时我国公路建设史上一次性投资最大的项目。太旧高速是山西省第一条高速公路，1988 年列入国家“八五”重点工程，1992 年 5 月获批立项，1993 年动工，1996 年 6 月 25 日全线通车。

其余路段大多在 2000 年后的十年间建成。夏汾段 2000 年 10 月通车，靖边至王圈梁（陕宁界）段 2004 年 1 月通车，汾阳至离石段 2005 年 10 月通车，河北清河至石家庄 182 公里于 2005 年 12 月 28 日通车。2005 年国家高速公路网规划将该线编为 G20。陕西吴子靖高速于 2007 年 10 月 31 日通车，陕西境内 321 公里全线贯通；山西境内最后一段离石至军渡于 2007 年 12 月 18 日通车。
原济青高速于 2010 年并入 G20，此后的工程以扩容为主。济青高速八车道改扩建工程小许家枢纽以东段于 2019 年 7 月 26 日通车，成为山东省首条八车道高速公路。山西太旧高速冀晋界至寿阳段 100.68 公里正在改扩建为八车道，2024 年 9 月 28 日开工。

en: No total has been published; the route was built as separate provincial projects over thirty years. The Jinan–Qingdao expressway cost 3.1 billion yuan in 1993, of which US$110 million was a World Bank loan and 715 million a grant from the Ministry of Communications, with Shandong raising the rest. Later sections cost more per kilometre: 4.62 billion for Hebei's 182 km (2005), 8.8 billion for Shaanxi's 188.9 km Wubu–Jingbian section (2007), and 2.59 billion for the 38.55 km from Lishi to Jundu (2007).

The rebuilding now costs more than the original road. The Jinan–Qingdao widening, financed by Shandong Hi-Speed Group, came to about 29.8 billion yuan, and the Taiyuan–Jiuguan widening is estimated at 18.09 billion, to be financed as a government toll road.
zh: 全线没有公开的总造价；它在三十年间由各省分别立项建成。济青高速 1993 年建成时总投资 31 亿元，其中世界银行贷款 1.1 亿美元、交通部补助 7.15 亿元，其余由山东省自筹。后来路段的每公里造价明显更高：河北段 182 公里概算 46.2 亿元（2005），陕西吴子靖段 188.9 公里概算 88 亿元（2007），离石至军渡 38.55 公里概算 25.856 亿元（2007）。
如今的改扩建比当初修路花钱更多。山东高速集团投资的济青高速改扩建总投资约 298 亿元；太旧高速改扩建估算总投资 180.93 亿元，拟采用政府收费公路模式实施。

en: In December 2013 the traffic bureau of the Ministry of Public Security ranked the Xuegongling section in Lüliang, because of its steep drop, first among the ten most dangerous road sections in China. In northern Shaanxi the limits from the Shanxi line to Yangqiaopan are 100 km/h for cars and 80 for other vehicles. In Qingdao the stretch between the Liuting and Qingdao toll stations is toll-free. The Taiyuan–Jiuguan section is under reconstruction; in March 2025 a wall collapse on the works at Yexi in Pingding county killed five people.
zh: 2013 年 12 月，公安部交通管理局因落差大，将吕梁薛公岭段列为全国十大危险路段之首。陕北省界至杨桥畔段小客车限速每小时 100 公里，其他车辆 80 公里。青岛流亭收费站至青岛收费站之间为免费路段。太旧段正在改扩建施工；2025 年 3 月，平定县冶西段工地发生墙体坍塌事故，5 人遇难。

why.en: No total has been published. G20 was built by five provinces between about 1990 and 2007 as separately financed projects, each accounted for on its own; sourced section figures are given below.
why.zh: 全线没有公开的总造价。G20 由五个省区在约 1990 至 2007 年间分别立项筹资、分别核算；下列为有来源的分段数字。

value.en: 3.1 billion yuan for 318 km, completed 1993, including a US$110 million World Bank loan and 715 million yuan from the Ministry of Communications
value.zh: 318 公里，1993 年建成，投资概算 31 亿元，其中世界银行贷款 1.1 亿美元、交通部补助 7.15 亿元

figures.source: Shandong Yearbook 1994, via Shandong Chorography (shandong-chorography.org); Qingdao Local Chronicles Office (qdsq.qingdao.gov.cn)

value.en: 4.62 billion yuan budgeted for 182 km, opened 28 December 2005

Lishi–Jundu, 38.55 km: 2.5856 billion yuan budgeted (2005–2007). Wubu–Zizhou–Jingbian, 188.9 km: 8.8 billion budgeted (2004–2007). For Taiyuan–Jiuguan the Ministry of Communications proposed a total of 3 billion in December 1992; the final cost was not found.
value.zh: 离石至军渡 38.55 公里概算 25.856 亿元（2005—2007）；吴子靖段 188.9 公里概算 88 亿元（2004—2007）。太旧高速 1992 年 12 月交通部建议总投资 30 亿元，最终决算未查到。

figures.source: Shanxi Evening News, 19 December 2007, via Sina; CCTV.com, 30 October 2007; Xi'an News Network, 31 October 2007, archived; Guo Yuhuai, Shanxi Jiaotong Keji, 1994 (5), as cited in Chinese Wikipedia, 太旧高速公路

value.en: Jinan–Qingdao to eight lanes, 309 km: about 29.8 billion yuan (29.796 billion), 2016–2019. Taiyuan–Jiuguan (Hebei line to Shouyang) to eight lanes, 100.68 km: 18.093 billion estimated, begun 2024.
value.zh: 济青段四改八 309 公里，总投资约 298 亿元（297.96 亿元），2016—2019；太旧段（冀晋界至寿阳）八车道改扩建 100.68 公里，估算总投资 180.93 亿元，2024 年开工。

figures.source: Xinhua, 26 July 2019; Dazhong Daily (dzwww.com), 26 July 2019; Xinhua, 2023, as cited in Chinese Wikipedia, 太旧高速公路

value.en: The provinces and their expressway companies, repaid from tolls; a US$110 million World Bank loan and a Ministry of Communications grant for Jinan–Qingdao; Shaanxi Communications Construction Group for Wubu–Jingbian; Shandong Hi-Speed Group for the Jinan–Qingdao widening; the Taiyuan–Jiuguan widening as a government toll road.
value.zh: 沿线各省及其高速公路公司出资，以通行费还贷；济青段有世界银行贷款 1.1 亿美元及交通部补助；吴子靖段项目法人为陕西省交通建设集团；济青改扩建由山东高速集团投资；太旧改扩建采用政府收费公路模式。

figures.source: Qingdao Local Chronicles Office; CCTV.com, 30 October 2007; Xinhua, 26 July 2019; Chinese Wikipedia, 太旧高速公路

value.en: 1,510 km on the chainage table in Chinese Wikipedia; English Wikipedia gives 1,600 km and older references 1,610 km
value.zh: 中文维基百科里程表为 1,510 公里；英文维基百科作 1,600 公里，较早资料作 1,610 公里

figures.source: Chinese Wikipedia, 青岛—银川高速公路; English Wikipedia, G20 Qingdao–Yinchuan Expressway

timeline.en: The Jinan–Qingdao expressway, Shandong's first, opens on 18 December.
timeline.zh: 12 月 18 日，山东省第一条高速公路济青高速全线通车。

timeline.en: The Taiyuan–Jiuguan expressway, Shanxi's first, is complete on 25 June.
timeline.zh: 6 月 25 日，山西省第一条高速公路太旧高速全线通车。

timeline.en: Jingbian–Wangquanliang in Shaanxi opens in January.
timeline.zh: 1 月，陕西靖边至王圈梁段通车。

timeline.en: The national plan numbers the line G20; Hebei's section opens on 28 December.
timeline.zh: 国家高速公路网规划将该线编为 G20；12 月 28 日，河北段通车。

timeline.en: A collapse near Shouyang in March closes the Taiyuan–Jiuguan road until 16 June.
timeline.zh: 3 月，太旧高速寿阳段塌陷，至 6 月 16 日恢复通车。

timeline.en: Wubu–Jingbian opens on 31 October and Lishi–Jundu on 18 December.
timeline.zh: 10 月 31 日吴子靖高速通车；12 月 18 日离石至军渡段通车。

timeline.en: The Jinan–Qingdao expressway is renumbered into G20.
timeline.zh: 济青高速并入青银高速 G20。

timeline.en: The Xuegongling section is ranked the most dangerous road section in China.
timeline.zh: 薛公岭段被列为全国十大危险路段之首。

timeline.en: The eight-lane Jinan–Qingdao rebuild opens east of Xiaoxujia on 26 July.
timeline.zh: 7 月 26 日，济青高速八车道改扩建小许家枢纽以东段通车。

timeline.en: Widening of the Taiyuan–Jiuguan road begins on 28 September.
timeline.zh: 9 月 28 日，太旧高速改扩建工程开工。
